purpose: Original English voice identity and delivery auditions; no training or runtime replacement
source_route: Owner chose expressive pretrained tools locally as potential training source on 2026-10-11
text: Hey, you made it. Grab a seat; I'm fixing this gate. Did you change that setting? Wait... it worked! Okay, that was actually awesome. Oh. We lost the crew. Give me a second. We'll figure it out together.
delivery: One original adult woman throughout, speaking English with a General American accent. Speak naturally to a familiar friend, not to a crowd. Start relaxed and warmly welcoming. Ask 'Did you change that setting?' as a genuine curious question. Give 'Wait... it worked!' a spontaneous surprised lift, then restrained happy excitement. Let 'Oh. We lost the crew. Give me a second.' become quietly disappointed, with a small meaningful pause rather than exaggerated sobbing. Finish 'We'll figure it out together' with gentle reassurance. Keep clear diction, normal contractions, context-appropriate stress and varied phrase timing. Maintain one speaker identity through the emotional changes. Avoid a forced announcer cadence, constant upspeak, shrillness, nasal caricature, breathy whispering or theatrical shouting.
